annotation.summary_en: Brief report analysing the US FTC's 2024 enforcement action against DoNotPay, the self-styled "robot lawyer" chatbot, under Operation AI Comply. It weighs four policy options and recommends continued case-by-case enforcement under existing law, supplemented by voluntary ethical self-regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: No exemption from existing consumer protection law for AI; FTC Act Section 5 applies to deceptive AI claims.
Four options: no action, case-by-case enforcement, comprehensive AI legislation, industry self-regulation.
Recommends hybrid of case-by-case enforcement plus voluntary codes on truthfulness, accountability, transparency and oversight.
FTC Chair Ferguson cautions against comprehensive federal AI legislation at this stage.
DoNotPay is a chatbot, not a physical robot.
annotation.title_clean: AI Consumer Protection and the Robot Lawyer: Policy Optionality in the FTC's DoNotPay Case
annotation.title_en: AI Consumer Protection and the Robot Lawyer: Policy Optionality in the FTC's DoNotPay Case
